note: Adair County Conservation campground on the north shore of 24-acre Lake Orient, in an 86-acre park 1 mi west of Orient on Hwy 25. Level sites, several on spurs that end at the shoreline; boat dock in the campground, boat ramp, kayak dock, two shelters, playground, walking trail, shower building with tornado safe room (2017). The dump station is in the town of Orient, 1 mi east ($3). Henry A. Wallace marker in the park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 22 sites, FCFS self-register, $20 (posted 'effective April 1, 2022'). Changed electric 50->30 (two 30A + two 20A outlets per site); max stay 14 nights. Season is year-round, with utilities April 1-October 30. Showers and hydrant drinking water confirmed; the dump station is in town. Lakefront lead for the shore-spur sites.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: not waterfront -> lakefront (mixed). The operator says the sites are 'close to the lake' with 'One boat dock is provided in the campground'. Imagery at 0.27 m/px shows the south spurs of the loop ending at the north shore. At least 4-5 occupied pads (about 41.19975-41.19995, -94.4372 to -94.4378) sit ~10-20 m from the water across open mown lawn, with no road or day use between; a narrow pale band at the water's edge looks like riprap, not a drive. The campground dock is at the shore below them. The north half of the loop is under trees, 60-120 m back. The lake is 24 acres, well over the pond threshold. Needs a human call because it would be an upgrade.

FEES: the only posted rate is 'Effective April 1, 2022 ... Electric/water sites $20.00 per night', still posted on the live facility page in 2026. That is older than the 2024 dating rule, so fees were left as stored.

HOOKUPS water: the park page says '22 trailer campsites with electricity and water', but the campground page describes 'four hydrants located in the campground to provide drinking water'. That reads as shared water, not a hookup at each site, so water was left unwritten. The old note's '30/50-amp' was wrong: the page lists 30- and 20-amp outlets only.

SEASON: the park page says utilities and showers May-September, while the campground page says utilities April 1-October 30 and showers mid-April to mid-October. The campground page's dates were used; both say the campground stays open without utilities in the off season.
PIN OK (centre of the loop by the shower building). Phone 641-743-6450 confirmed.
